C0300.title: KillNet Group Leverages CC-Attack Script for DDoS Campaigns
C0300.summary: SecurityScorecard reported on May 25, 2022 that recent KillNet DDoS campaigns leveraged the publicly available CC-Attack script. The script automates the use of open proxy servers to relay attack traffic and can generate GET, HEAD, and POST Layer 7 floods, while randomizing request fields to make signature-based mitigation harder.

references.title: KillNet Utilizes CC-Attack: A Quick & Dirty DDoS Method
